edges.reason: Constructor assigns the LumosToken reference to lumos.
Constructor assigns _devaddr to devaddr.
Constructor stores the derived Uniswap pair address.
Constructor hardcodes 24h minimum TWAP interval.
start_crafting writes the current timestamp to startBlockTime.
start_crafting sets lumosPerBlock from getLumosPerBlock.
start_crafting initializes lmsPriceMultiplier to 1e18.
start_crafting calls massUpdatePools after initialization.
end_crafting sets craftingEnded true once the supply threshold is passed.
end_crafting records the current block in endBlock.
init_TWAP stores the observed blockTimestamp.
init_TWAP stores the observed cumulative price.
init_TWAP records timeOfInitTWAP for rate limiting.
add increases totalAllocPoint by the new allocation.
add pushes a new PoolInfo entry.
add records the pool id in poolId1.
set adjusts totalAllocPoint when a pool allocation changes.
set rewrites the pool allocPoint in poolInfo.
getTWAP overwrites blockTimestampLast after computing the average.
getTWAP overwrites priceCumulativeLast after computing the average.
getCurrentTWAP reads blockTimestampLast to compute elapsed time.
getCurrentTWAP reads priceCumulativeLast for the price delta.
getMultiplier multiplies lumosPerBlock by the block count.
getMultiplier applies lmsPriceMultiplier to the per-block rate.
pendingLumos reads pool state for the given pid.
pendingLumos reads user accounting from userInfo.
massUpdatePools loops calling updatePool for every pool.
updatePool mutates pool.accLumosPerShare and lastRewardBlock.
updatePool performs external lumos.mint calls for dev and pool rewards.
deposit writes user.amount, rewardDebt and lastHarvestBlock.
deposit calls updatePool before computing pending rewards.
withdraw calls updatePool before paying pending rewards.
emergencyWithdraw reads the pool LP token for transfer.
emergencyWithdraw zeroes user.amount and rewardDebt.
safeLMSTransfer invokes the external LMS token transfer, an attacker-controlled token could re-enter.
setLumosPerBlock writes the recomputed per-block emission.
setLMSPriceMultiplier calls massUpdatePools before returning.
setLMSPriceMultiplier delegates to setLMSPriceMultiplierInt.
getCurrentPriceMultiplier reads the current TWAP.
getCurrentPriceMultiplier reads the ETH/USD price.
setLMSPriceMultiplierInt assigns the tiered multiplier.
setLMSPriceMultiplierInt refreshes lumosPerBlock.
setLMSPriceMultiplierInt calls getTWAP which updates oracle snapshots.
setStartBlock writes the mining start block.
setDevFundDivRate updates the dev-fund divisor.
setminLMSTWAPIntervalSec updates the TWAP interval guard.
poolLength reads poolInfo.length.
msg.sender indexes userInfo and receives rewards in deposit without ownership check.
msg.sender indexes userInfo and is paid out in withdraw.
msg.sender indexes userInfo in emergencyWithdraw and receives LP tokens.
pendingLumos is called with an arbitrary caller-supplied _user.
init_TWAP derives oracle state from block.timestamp, which miners can influence.
getTWAP divides by timestamp-derived timeElapsed, a timestamp-dependent price computation.
getLumosPerBlock derives emission from now-startBlockTime, a timestamp dependency.
setLMSPriceMultiplier rate-limit check uses now, allowing timestamp manipulation of updates.
getCurrentPriceMultiplier depends on the timestamp-based TWAP.
getTWAP performs unchecked cumulative-price subtraction and division by timeElapsed.
getLumosPerBlock uses sqrt and wdiv fixed-point arithmetic on elapsed days.
deposit computes rewardDebt and pending using wmul/wdiv fixed-point math.
updatePool computes accLumosPerShare and dev share via wmul/wdiv.
pendingLumos computes pending rewards via wmul/wdiv, vulnerable to rounding.
getMultiplier uses wmul on lumosPerBlock*lmsPriceMultiplier*blockCount.
withdraw pays pending LMS via safeLMSTransfer before updating user.amount, violating checks-effects-interactions.
deposit pays pending LMS before user.amount/rewardDebt are finalized, allowing reentrancy.
deposit mints the harvest bonus to msg.sender before user state is fully updated.
withdraw transfers LP tokens externally before final user.rewardDebt write.
deposit pulls LP tokens via external safeTransferFrom from an arbitrary token.
emergencyWithdraw transfers LP tokens before zeroing user.amount, classic reentrancy ordering.
_pid selects the pool updated by updatePool.
_pid selects pool and user entry in deposit.
_pid selects pool and user entry in withdraw.
_pid selects pool and user entry in emergencyWithdraw.
_pid selects the pool read by pendingLumos.
_amount is the LP quantity deposited and added to user.amount.
_amount is the LP quantity withdrawn and subtracted from user.amount.
_user addresses the userInfo entry queried by pendingLumos.
_to is the LMS transfer recipient in safeLMSTransfer.
_allocPoint sets the new pool's allocation weight in add.
_allocPoint replaces the pool allocation weight in set.
_lpToken is stored in the new PoolInfo and poolId1.
_from is the starting block used by getMultiplier.
_lastHarvestBlock determines the blocks-elapsed harvest bonus.
pending local is the reward paid out during deposit.
multiplier local scales the pool reward in updatePool.
lpSupply local is the denominator normalizing accLumosPerShare.
timeElapsed local divides the cumulative price delta in getTWAP.
priceAverage local holds the uq112x112 TWAP before decoding.
_price local drives the tiered multiplier selection.
_harvestBonus local is minted to the depositor above 1e18.
_harvestMultiplier local boosts the pending reward in deposit.
_lumosPerBlock local is stored back to lumosPerBlock when changed.

normalization_plan.reason: _pid is only used to index poolInfo/userInfo inside updatePool.
_amount is consumed immediately as the deposited LP quantity in deposit.
_user only addresses the userInfo lookup in pendingLumos.
_to is the immediate recipient argument of the LMS transfer in safeLMSTransfer.
_allocPoint is normalized into the pool allocation written by add.
_lpToken is stored directly into the new PoolInfo by add.
_from is only the block-range start used by getMultiplier.
_lastHarvestBlock is used solely to compute the harvest multiplier.
pending local holds the reward amount paid during deposit.
multiplier local is an intermediate of the reward computation in updatePool.
lpSupply local only normalizes pending reward shares in pendingLumos.
timeElapsed local is the divisor of the TWAP delta in getTWAP.
priceAverage local is the intermediate uq112x112 TWAP in getTWAP.
_price local is the combined price used for tiering in getCurrentPriceMultiplier.
_harvestBonus local is the minted bonus amount inside deposit.
_harvestMultiplier local is the bonus factor applied in deposit.
_lumosPerBlock local is the recomputed emission written back by setLumosPerBlock.
